jd_text: At RAKBANK , we believe in fostering a culture of innovation, growth, and excellence. We are not just a bank – we are a community that thrives on teamwork, cutting-edge solutions, and the highest standards of governance. About the role In this role, you will oversee and drive enterprise-wide transformation by designing and executing strategic initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, productivity, and customer experience across the bank. Lead process optimization and AI-driven automation to modernize operating models, unlock value, and ensure scalable, data-driven decision-making. Partner with senior stakeholders to embed sustainable change, strong governance, and measurable business outcomes in a highly regulated environment. What You’ll Be Doing: Define and lead the bank’s enterprise transformation strategy aligned with business objectives and target operating model. Drive large-scale, cross-functional transformation programs across retail, corporate banking, operations, risk, finance, compliance, and support functions. Develop and manage a transformation roadmap with clear KPIs, governance frameworks, milestones, and value realization tracking. Lead cross-functional teams/squads to ensure disciplined execution across multiple transformation workstreams. Identify process inefficiencies and redesign workflows using Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous improvement methodologies. Drive simplification, standardization, and optimization of end-to-end banking processes while fostering a culture of operational excellence. Lead enterprise adoption of intelligent automation and AI solutions, including RPA, workflow orchestration, generative AI, and predictive analytics. Partner with technology and data teams to deliver scalable, compliant AI-enabled capabilities and define governance and adoption frameworks. Deliver measurable productivity gains, cost efficiencies, and scalable operating models through data-driven performance frameworks. Optimize workforce utilization, service delivery, and capacity management while maintaining strong customer experience and compliance standards. Engage senior stakeholders to drive alignment, lead change management, and ensure adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working. Establish robust governance, PMO standards, and delivery frameworks to ensure initiatives are executed on time, within budget, and in compliance with regulatory and risk requirements. What We’re Looking For: Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, Finance, or related field. Master’s degree or MBA preferred. Experience: 15+ years of experience in banking, financial services, consulting, or enterprise transformation roles. Proven track record leading large-scale transformation programs within banking or highly regulated industries. Industry: Banking, financial services, consulting What Should You Have: Proven expertise in Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt/Master Black Belt), Agile/Scrum methodologies, and process transformation frameworks. Strong experience in implementing RPA, AI, and automation platforms with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes. Demonstrated analytical mindset with data-driven decision-making capabilities and a strong focus on performance metrics and ROI realization. Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership across complex organizations. Strong financial acumen with hands-on experience in cost optimization, productivity improvement, and benefits realization tracking. Proven track record in leading large-scale, global or regional transformation programs, delivering operational efficiency, automation adoption, and enhanced customer experience. Strategic and resilient leader with a collaborative style, strong problem-solving and systems-thinking ability, and the capability to drive change effectively in matrix environments.c What’s In It For You: Competitive, performance-linked compensation. Medical coverage for you and your family. Comprehensive life insurance. Inclusive and diverse workplace culture. Career development and fast-track growth opportunities. Mentorship from industry experts.
